value.rationale: Recovering a hidden Markov environmental rate and ordered noise levels solely from stationary position snapshots is a natural inverse experimental problem. The sharp realizable open region, exact missing-information obstruction through moment seven, and optimal degree-eight cutoff are substantive structural facts not supplied merely by listing forward moments. Inaccessible earlier related texts pose a priority risk, and empirical eighth-moment estimation accuracy is outside scope.
